system.description: You recite the old words against the dark, loud enough to be heard over the gloom. Test Agility (DR16). On a success, you and allies within 20' of you defend against gloom abilities with -2 DR. Sustained. While you sustain it, you cannot make shoot attacks.

outcomes.ruin: You lose your place in the words: no effect, and you are Stupefied until the end of your next turn.
